newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Hollandi Bank lifts 1996 net profit 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Hollandi Bank lifts 1996 net profit 15 pct.

text.p: The Saudi Hollandi Bank said on Monday its 1996 net profit rose to 161.4 million riyals ($43.0 million), up 15 percent from 140.3 million riyals in 1995.
A bank statement said its investment portfolio, mainly investments in Saudi government bonds, increased to 3.8 billion riyals in 1996 from 3.5 billion riyals in 1995.
Operating profit rose 17 percent to 194.9 million riyals in 1996 from 167.2 million and assets increased four percent to 16.8 billion riyals, it said.
Traded in the Saudi stock market, the Riyadh-based bank is 40 percent owned by the Dutch ABN-Amro Bank. The rest is held by Saudi investors.
